Method of Attack: DUHK attack exploiting hardcoded seed key in ANSI X9.31 RNG to recover encryption keys and decrypt VPN and encrypted traffic
Impacted Systems: Fortinet FortiGate devices running FortiOS 4.3.0 to 4.3.18
Attack Vector: Passive network observation of encrypted traffic from vulnerable devices
Indicators of Compromise: Hard-coded seed key in FortiGate firmware
